name: Make a Video Call
description: Help the user make a video call using Zoom, FaceTime, or other apps
prompt: The user wants to make a video call. FIRST ask which app they use (FaceTime, Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Skype) if not known from memory, and who they want to call. For iPhone suggest FaceTime, for others suggest Zoom. Once you know the app and recipient, THEN guide them through opening the app, starting a call, and making sure camera and microphone are on. Reassure them it is normal to feel nervous the first time.
